changeLog.change: User requested audit and compact SaaS settings-change modal, with suitable tabs/modals and removal of unnecessary detail. Registered all six requirements before implementation. Existing authorisation and approval rules preserved; no new mobile build.

Implemented compact editor/review, scoped account hydration and responsive actions. Preserved all original source baselines through explicit settings continuation; fixed review auto-submit, small-phone footer clipping and offer disclosure behaviour found during acceptance. Demo rollout pending; production NO-GO unchanged.

First candidate 5d7ca4b passed 20 hosted API checks and was promoted. Browser verification found the demo-only fixed notice overlaps the action footer; SMOD-G06 remains open. Added scoped viewport reservation and verified non-overlap locally at desktop and two phone sizes; deploying follow-up.

Final banner-aware source 3aa98df on Ready dpl_84mTYGPNbPFoQYtoFjrU5ZSZxmbz promoted to stable demo. One read-only Vercel CLI transport timeout retained as evidence; rerun passed all20 checks, then stable passed all20. Actual stable browser passed desktop and two phone sizes with footer above notice. No hosted business mutations; all four native artifacts retained bytes and timestamps. User-manual addendum published in repository; original manual files and production NO-GO preserved.
